name: sidebar-08
title: Sidebar 08
description: An inset sidebar with secondary navigation: the pad has a margin round it and the page becomes a sheet of paper set on the desk beside it. Rows fold open from a chevron, projects keep their menus, support and feedback sit at the foot. Mirrors shadcn's sidebar-08. At its best on the desk.

files.content: import * as React from "react" import { BrandTile, BrandText } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-brand" import { appNav, appProjects, appSecondary, appUser } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-data" import { NavMainFolds, NavProjects, NavSecondary } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-nav-app" import { NavUser } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-user-menu" import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarHeader, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem } from "@/components/ui/sidebar" export function AppSidebar({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps) { return ( ) }

import { AppSidebar } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-08/components/sidebar-08-app-sidebar"
import { containedClasses } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-contained"
import { PageBody, PageHeader, PageNote, PageSheet } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-page"
import { SidebarProvider } from "@/components/ui/sidebar"

export default function Page({ contained = false }: { contained?: boolean }) {
  const c = containedClasses(contained)
  return (
    <SidebarProvider className={c.provider}>
      <AppSidebar className={c.sidebar} />
      <PageSheet className={c.inset}>
        <PageHeader crumbs={[{ label: "Sketchbook", href: "#sketchbook" }, "Recent"]} />
        <PageBody title="Recent sketches" kicker="Sketchbook">
          <PageNote title="Two sheets on the desk" pose="search">
            The pad keeps its distance and the page rests beside it; on a phone the pad slides in over it. Fold a row open to look inside.
          </PageNote>
        </PageBody>
      </PageSheet>
    </SidebarProvider>
  )
}
